select "id", "scope_id", "name_ct", "phone_ct", "address_ct", "memo_ct", "email_ct", "company_ct" from "native_verify_main"."customers" where ("native_verify_main"."customers"."scope_id" = $1 and "customers"."id" in (
    with sample as materialized (
      select "row_id","tokens_f289b89d86c7086a" from "native_verify_main"."customers_seal_index" as "c"
      where "c"."scope_id"=$2 order by "c"."row_id" limit 256
    ), quick as materialized (
      select "c"."row_id" from sample as "c" where "c"."tokens_f289b89d86c7086a" @> $3::bigint[] order by "c"."row_id" limit $4
    ), fallback as materialized (
      select "c"."row_id" from "native_verify_main"."customers_seal_index" as "c"
      where "c"."scope_id"=$5 and "c"."tokens_f289b89d86c7086a" @> $6::bigint[]
        and (select count(*) from quick)<$7
      order by "c"."row_id" limit $8
    )
    select row_id from quick where (select count(*) from quick)=$9
    union all select row_id from fallback
  )) order by "native_verify_main"."customers"."id" asc limit $10
